book.name: MATEO
book.title: JA' WATX' K'ANE TZ'IBEBIL CAN YU NAJ MATEO

content: Jix Sic' El Eb Lacawan Scuywom Naj Jesús

Ja' yet tu', jix yawtentej eb lacawan scuywom Jesús. Catu' jix yak'on yopiso eb yin i'o can el pena espíritu yin ánima. Jix yak'on pax can yopiso eb yin ak'o can wa'xo sc'ul ánima yin yal c'al tzet ya'bilal, c'al yin yal c'al tzet sya'ilal.
Ja' sbi eb ti': Simón, naj chi al-le pax Pedro, yetoj jun yuẍtaj naj chi yij Andrés. Jacobo, yetoj pax jun yuẍtaj chi yij Juan. Ja' eb cawan tzunan ti', sc'aal naj Zebedeo eb.

Ey jun chi yij Felipe, ey jun chi yij Bartolomé. Ey jun chi yij Tomás. Ey jun chi yij Mateo, naj tejom el tolabal yet yalantoj. Ey jun xa chi yij Jacobo, naj sc'aal naj Alfeo. Ey jun chi yij Lebeo, chi yij pax naj yin Tadeo.
Ey jun xa chi yij Simón, yetbi sba yetoj eb Cananista
yet yalan toj. Ey jun chi yij Judas Iscariote, naj jix aon oc Jesús yul sk'ab camich.
Jix Chejletoj Eb Lacawan Yu Jesús Yu Sto Yal-le El Sk'aneal

Catu' jix chejletoj eb lacawan ti' yu Jesús. Pero ja' yet c'am to chi to eb, jix yalon wan chejbanile ti' tet eb, jix yal jaxca ti': —Manchej jex ec' bey wan lugar bey ey ec' eb man Israel oj. Manaj pax bey wan conoblaj yul yet Samaria.
Asan bey eb q'ueynaj toj xol eb ket Israelal chex eq'ui. Yutol ja' eb, jaxca junoj no' me' chi q'uey ec' oj, quey tu' ye eb.
Chi ec' je yal el oj, tol ja' naj Yaaw a satcan tuxa chi oc can Yaawil titi'.

Ja' eb ya' ey yu lepra, che yak' can wa'xoj sc'ul eb, c'al jantaj eb ya' ey yu yal c'al tzet ya'bilal. Che pitzc'une can a eb camnaj. Catu' che yi'on can el pena espíritu yin eb ánima. Tu' c'al chi wak' jun opiso ti' e ex, yuxan manchej je k'an je tool tet eb bey oj je yak'balne tu'.
C'am c'al nioj tzet che yi' yet chex toi. Manchej je yi' ch'en oro, ma ch'en plata, c'am junoj centavo che yi'toj.

Manchej je yi'toj je morral yu yet je be. Junne je camiẍ che yaoc oj yet chex toi. C'am che yi'toj junoj xa moan je xanab, c'am che yi'toj junoj xa je k'ojoch. Chi wal wan ti' e ex, yutol smasanil eb mulnawom, smoo ẍa'on sgasto eb.
Ja' yet chex apni bey jun jun conob, c'al bey jun jun aldea, ja' bey sna junoj mac txequel watx' sbeybal chex ey eyi, masanta' c'al chex to bey junoj xa lugar.
Ja' yet chex apni bey jun jun na, “Ey ojab je watx' c'ulal yetoj Dios,” je chi tet eb.
Ta yel ey watx' c'ulal eb yetoj Dios che yila, oj jex cha'le yu eb. Ta c'amaj, man oj jex cha'le yu eb.

Ta c'am chex cha'le yu eb, catu' c'am pax chi ẍa' eb yab tzet che yala, chex el bey sna eb tu', c'al yul sconob eb tu'. Che tzic can el spojojal je yajan yu je tx'oxon el oj tol c'am je yalon je yet yin eb, catu' chex toi.
Caw yel chi wal e ex, ja' yet oj jul jun c'ual chi na'le oc yin eb ánima, yel miman sya'tajilal oj ẍa' eb ma jex cha'on tu' yintaj eb ánima a conob Sodoma c'al Gomorra.
Ja' Sya'ilal Oj Jul Yiban Eb Yet Xa Cristo
Ilala, tol chex jin chejtoj xol ánima jaxca tol chin chejtoj no' me' xol no' oj. Yuxan, listo c'al che yute je ba jaxca junoj no' laba caw jelan. Pero suc che yute je ba jaxca no' uch.
Che yil c'al je ba, yutol ey eb oj jex i'ontoj sattaj eb yaaw. Catu' oj jex mak'le yu eb yul-laj snail sculto eb ket Israelal.
Oj jex i'letoj sattaj eb mimej yaaw, c'al sattaj eb rey jin ya'il oj. Ja' titu' oj ske' je yalon can el jin k'aneal, c'al tet eb man Israel oj.
Ja' yet oj jex i'letoj sattaj eb yaaw tu', manchej jex oc bis c'ulal yu tzet oj je yala. Yutol ja' yet jun txolan tu', ja' Dios oj ak'on na'cha el je yu tzet oj je yala.
Manaj jex oj jex k'anab oj, pero tol ja Yespíritu cu Mam Dios oj maanen je ti', catu' ja' oj k'anab je yin.

Ja' yet jun tiempoal tu', ey eb yuẍtaj sba oj yaoc yuẍtaj eb yul sk'ab camich. Ey pax eb mame oj yaoc yuninal yul sk'ab camich. Ey bey xin, oj yak'le jowal eb uninale yetoj smam c'al xutx, catu' oj yaon oc smam c'al xutx eb tu' yul sk'ab camich.
Masanil eb ánima oj tit sjowal je yin wu c'al. Pero ja' mac eb oj techa yu masanil, oj colcha oj.

Ja' yet pena chi yute sba eb e ex, bey jun conob bey ey jex ec' oj, elan nej a oj catu' chex to bey junoj xa conob. Caw yel chi wal e ex c'am to c'al chi lawi je yec' bey masanil sconoblaj eb ket Israelal tu', catu' oj jin jul pax junel xa, jain Ak'bil Wopiso xol eb ket animail yu Dios.
C'am junoj cuywom ec'ban yel oc apnoj yintaj scuywam. C'am pax junoj moso ec'ban yel oc apnoj yintaj spatrón.

Ta tol laan junoj cuywom yetoj scuywam, watx' ton jaxca tu' chi yune'. Quey pax tu' junoj moso yetoj spatrón. Jainti', jaxca tol a na jin. Jal jex xin, jaxca tol uninale jex. Ey mac chi aloni tol Beelzebú jin, naj yaawil eb pena espíritu. Ta chi al-le jaxca tu' win an, yel xa c'al pena oj al-le je yin.
Asanne Ojab Tet Dios Chi Cu Xiwi
Yuxan manchej jex xiw tet ánima. Yutol ja' masanil jantaj tzet yetal majan ey tinani', oj txeclo a oj. Yetoj jantaj tzet yetal ewan c'uan yei, oj ak'le otajnele el oj.
Ja' wan tzet chi wal e ex yin ewantajil, al wej el masanil tet ánima. Yetoj wan tu' c'al chin sa' je yabe, al wej el yul-laj calle.
Manchej jex xiw tet eb chi ske' jex yak'on cam oj, yutol ¿Toj oj ske' yak'on cam je pixan eb? Ja' tet Dios smoo chex xiwi, yutol chi ske' jex yak'on cam oj, catu' chi yaontoj je pixan bey infierno.

I' wej je cuenta yin no' ni'tej tz'iquin tinani', c'am yel oc apnoj no', cac'on no' chi txonle yin centavo. Cax c'al c'am yel oc apnoj no', pero c'am junoj no' comon c'al chi cami, c'am chi ey q'uey sat tx'otx' ta c'am chi el yin sc'ul cu Mam Dios.
Jaexti', yel miman je yel oc apnoj yintaj no' tu'. Ja' xil je jolom masanil bisbil yu Dios. Yuxan, manchej jex xiwi.
Ja' Eb C'am Chi Q'uixwi Yaloni, Tol Yet Cristo Eb
Yal c'al mac txequel c'am chi q'uixwi yalon sattaj ánima tol wet an, oj wal oc eb wetoj sattaj cu Mam Dios ey ec' satcan.
Pero ja' eb chi alon sattaj ánima tol man wet oj an, oj wal pax sattaj cu Mam Dios ey ec' satcan tol man wet oj pax eb an.
Ey Mac Oj Yak'le A Jowal Sya'il Oj C'al Jesús
Manchej je na' tol oj oc watx' c'ulal xol eb ánima yul yiban k'inal ti' yutol jix jin jul an. Man oj oc watx' c'ulal xol eb yutol jix jin jul an. Pero oj scajlen a sba eb, yutol jix jin jul an.
Yu jix jin jul an, oj scajlen a sba naj winaj yetoj smam, c'al oj scajlen a sba ix ix yetoj xutx, c'al oj scajlen a sba ix alibe yetoj yalib.
Yuxan ja' c'al oc eb junne nail ye tu', oj scajle a sba eb. Ja' eb cajat ey oc eb yul sna.
Ja' mac txequel yel miman yel oc apnoj smam xutx wintaj an, man smoo oj yoc wetoj an. Ja'c'ala' pax eb tol yel miman yel oc apnoj sc'aal ma scutz'in yul sat wintaj an, man smoo oj eb yoc wetoj an.
Ja' eb c'am chi yal sc'ul chi yil sya'ilal jin ya'il oj an, eb c'am chi yal sc'ul chi ale oc yin culus jin ya'il oj an, man smoo oj eb yoc wetoj an.
Ja' eb asanne scawil chi sya' ilne yul yiban k'inal ti', oj q'uey el sk'inal eb yin junelne. Jal eb bejan sc'ul scam jin ya'il oj an, ja' ton eb tu', oj ẍa' k'inale tol ey c'al yin tobal k'inal.
Ja' Eb Oj Ak'le Spaj Yu Dios
Ja' eb chex cha'oni, jain chin ẍa' eb. Ja' eb chin cha'on tu', lalan pax ẍa'on eb mac jix jin chejontej an.

Ja' mac chi cha'on junoj ẍejab Dios, asan yutol ẍejab Dios, jaxca spaj jun ẍejab Dios tu' oj yi', quey pax tu' oj yi' jun chi cha'on tu'. Ja' mac chi ẍa'on junoj mac txequel tol watx' sbeybal, asan yutol watx' sbeybal tu', jaxca spaj oj yi' jun watx' sbeybal tu', quey pax tu' oj yi' jun chi ẍa'on tu'.

Yal c'al mac txequel chi sa'on asan junoj wasu siquil ja' yuc' junoj eb jin cuywom, asan yutol jin cuywom, cax c'al junoj eb c'am yel oc apnoj. Ja' jun chi sa'on jun siquil ja' tu' oj ẍa' spaj siquil ja' tu'.

footnotes.text: Eb Canaanista, chi yal yel oc apnoj sbi jun bulan eb ac'ul oc yin naj yaaw bey Roma. Chi yoche eb chi el yalan naj yaaw tu', catu' chi oc jun yaawil eb yul yet xojli.
Ja' x'otx'al eb Israel caw k'axan tx'otx', catu' tajin tx'otx' pax oj, yuxan ja' yet chi sa'le junoj vaso siquil ja', jun watx' c'ulal tet eb ec'abwom.
